goal: Using a real rendered browser, open https://httpbin.org/forms/post, enter PROJECT BRAIN into the customer name field, choose Medium pizza size, check the Bacon topping, submit the form, save a full-page screenshot to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/COMPOSED_HTTPBIN_SUBMISSION.png, and save the rendered result to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/COMPOSED_HTTPBIN_SUBMISSION.json. Create canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/COMPOSED_HTTPBIN_NORMALIZED.json containing a top-level submissions object with exactly one record named httpbin whose status is VERIFIED_BROWSER_SUBMISSION and whose customer_name, size, topping, and final_url values come from the browser result. Create canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/COMPOSED_HTTPBIN_SUBMISSION.xlsx from that normalized JSON with columns submission_id, status, customer_name, size, topping, and final_url. Finally independently reopen the XLSX and verify it contains exactly the one normalized JSON record with every value identical.
